basis: Preserved B1 sensor and magnet poses; consolidated electronics and separate mechanically registered backer.

pcb.ground_layer: In1.Cu and B.Cu ground pours around signal routes; continuity checked by KiCad
notes: No DC/DC converter or magnetic inductor on the sensing board.
Use one TCA branch at a time; all magnetic heads retain address 0x0C.
Keep the continuity resistors at the far ends of both nail leads, not on this PCB.
Do not change Hall axes or sensor-center positions when simplifying packaging.
Four-layer stack and copper balance need fabricator review before ordering.
Board registration uses the two existing B1 side-mount axes.
Spacers bottom on the rigid frame, not the bending TPU.
Two separate shouldered spacers register the PCB, which is sandwiched between the spacer faces and a removable backer.
The board is clamped on bare annuli; electrical copper stays outside the fastener keepout. The 0.825 mm nominal shoulder wall must be inspected after printing.
Confirm jaw housing, connector, cable and fastener length on the actual installed drive.
